name: Diff Viewer
description: This plugin shows diffs in ANSI colors. It adds the DiffViewerShowDiff tool.

tool.name: ShowDiff
tool.description:
Show a diff in the `diff -u` format to the user, in ANSI colors. Use it when the diff is the primary content of your response. For a hunk in a longer text, write the `%%sideband:open diff%%` tag, then the diff text, then the end tag. The tag has one optional attribute, `title`. Do not put the patch text directly in your response.

The tool gives you the patch text with no change. Only the user sees the colors: added lines are lime green and removed lines are pink.

patch.description: The full diff text in the `diff -u` format, for example from `git diff`.

title.description: A title. The user sees it above the diff.

sideband.summary: The model shows a diff to the user.
